analysis_type: Read-only post-hoc arithmetic audit of fixed local-sensitivity multiples at all frozen held-out points; no refitting, covariance recomputation or probability calibration

rules.threshold_selection: All three multipliers are frozen before inspecting point-level coverage outcomes; no threshold optimization or post-hoc selection
rules.coverage: A point is covered at multiplier k when absolute held-out residual is less than or equal to k times its stored local linearized prediction standard deviation
rules.residual: Use the absolute value of each stored held-out residual and retain its original sign, x and prediction for traceability
rules.zero_standard_deviation: When local standard deviation is zero, zero residual is covered and nonzero residual is a violation; do not divide by zero
rules.residual_sensitivity_ratio: When local standard deviation is positive, compute absolute residual divided by it; zero-deviation cases remain separate
rules.violation_details: Retain every violating point, its dataset, fold, point index, x, residual, local standard deviation, ratio when defined and failed multipliers
rules.nested_check: Coverage counts must be nondecreasing from multiplier 1 to 2 to 4 at every fold, dataset and total
rules.fold_summary: For every fold and multiplier report point count, covered count, violation count, zero-violation indicator and maximum residual/sensitivity ratio
rules.dataset_summary: Aggregate raw counts only within each dataset and preserve all fifteen fold summaries
rules.descriptive_totals: Overall counts are arithmetic inventories across 407 points and 1221 evaluations, not probabilities, confidence levels, calibration scores or expected coverage
rules.source_preservation: Do not rerun optimizers, SVD, covariance, period fitting or native prediction fitting; use stored predictions, residuals and local standard deviations only
rules.scope_specific_evidence: Keep Roszman1 parameter variation, Chwirut1 related-study and denominator scope, and ENSO period/known-answer boundaries separate from the threshold counts

output_rule.word: papers/前沿共生三模型敏感度阈值覆盖_图文完整版.docx

prohibitions: No refitting, retuning, covariance recomputation, changed folds or new local standard deviations
No conversion of fixed-threshold counts into probabilities, confidence intervals, credible intervals, calibration scores or expected coverage
No post-hoc threshold selection, hidden violations or removal of zero-deviation cases
No pooled physical interpretation across different response units and model structures
No claim of global identifiability, physical endogeneity, new periods, independent experiment or native deterministic error bounds
No rewriting of the three frozen local-identifiability inputs
